title: The history overlay specimen wears the shape history.css specifies
goal: The capture history panel is specified as a chromeless panel floating over the whole screen, but the reference page other pages copy still shows an older shape with a title bar and close button inside a window. This settles which shape is right and makes the reference say so.
notes: history.css says the capture history is a GLOBAL, chromeless pane: .sheet.down.hist with NO .sheet-h, whose only chrome is the centered .histbar (All / Screenshots / Videos + Clear All) over a .filmstrip, floating near the top of the SCREEN rather than inside a window. app-shell's 'History overlay' specimen and redline's #histSheet still draw the older shape: a .sheet.down with a .sheet-h title row and a close button, inside a window. Since app-shell is the spec other pages conform to, its version of a shared surface must match the component that owns it. Decide whether the in-window overlay is still a legitimate second form (an in-window convenience, per AGENTS 'an in-window History button is a convenience, never the taught path') or whether both should become .hist over a .desk like capture-wt does, then make the exemplar say so.
acceptance: A ruling is recorded on whether a history panel inside a window is still a legitimate second form
The reference page and the redline page both show the history panel in the agreed shape
Every touched page loads without error and passes the automated page sweep
